tooltip.name: Tooltip
tooltip.purpose: Provide short contextual explanation attached to a trigger without adding interactive content or changing the current task.

anatomy.rule: Owns focus, hover, and accessible description association.
Connects bubble to trigger visually when placement supports it.
Positions near the trigger and avoids viewport overflow.

variants.description: Clarifies an icon-only or compact control.
Defines a metric, table header, or dashboard value.
Explains why a control is unavailable.

tooltip.statePrecedence: disabled > dismissed > open > focus > hover > default

Energy.decision: Use Energy for high-contrast bubble and subtle trigger surfaces.
Energy.behavior: Bubble remains readable over documentation and product surfaces.

Voice.decision: Use Voice for one-sentence helper copy.
Voice.behavior: Tooltip text stays short and optional.
Voice.rejectIf: Tooltip contains instructions required for task completion.

Frame.decision: Use Frame for trigger spacing, bubble radius, arrow, and placement gap.
Frame.behavior: Bubble anchors near the trigger without crowding it.

Depth.decision: Use Depth to separate the bubble from the current surface.
Depth.behavior: Tooltip floats above dense UI without becoming a modal.
Depth.rejectIf: Tooltip appears as a card or dialog.

Momentum.decision: Use Momentum for quick fade and lift, with reduced motion support.
Momentum.rejectIf: Motion blocks reading or uses raw timing.

State.decision: Use State for default, hover, focus, open, disabled, and dismissed.
State.behavior: Visibility responds to trigger state and dismissal.

Tone.decision: Use Tone to keep explanation neutral and non-commanding.
Tone.behavior: Copy explains without sounding like an error or CTA.
Tone.example: Export unavailable until date range is selected.

Growth.decision: Use Growth so Tooltip can scale from toolbar helpers to dashboard definitions.
Growth.behavior: Escalates to Popover when content becomes richer.
Growth.example: Metric definitions become glossary pattern when repeated.

Symbol.decision: Use Symbol for optional trigger icon only.
Symbol.behavior: Icon clarifies the trigger, never replaces accessible text.
Symbol.example: Grid icon trigger with Grid label.

Iconography.decision: Use Iconography for compact trigger alignment.
Iconography.behavior: Icons fit the trigger without changing tooltip position.

Accessibility.decision: Use Accessibility for aria-describedby, keyboard focus, Escape dismissal, and non-interactive content.
Accessibility.behavior: Tooltip works for pointer and keyboard users.
Accessibility.rejectIf: Tooltip contains buttons, links, or inputs.

productExamples.example: Metric definition for cost per km.
Export unavailable until a date range is selected.

do: Dismiss on blur, Escape, and pointer leave.
dont: Do not replace Popover, Toast, Dialog, or inline validation.
info: Touch contexts may need an explicit help trigger or escalation to Popover.

contextDensityStrategy.layout: explicit help trigger; prefer bottom placement or inline helper
short anchored helpers with collision review
dense toolbar and metric helpers with hover and focus

agentInstructions: Use Tooltip only for optional short explanation.
Ask before hiding required instructions in Tooltip.
Escalate to Popover if content needs controls, links, or multiple sentences.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.notes: Called when local open state changes.

props.name: variant
props.notes: Purpose variant: default, icon-help, metric, or disabled-help.

props.name: density
props.notes: Controls trigger and bubble scale for sm, md, and lg contexts.

props.name: state
props.notes: Visibility state for default, hover, focus, open, disabled, or dismissed.

props.name: disabled
props.notes: Disables the trigger while keeping optional help visible when appropriate.

rejectIf: Required task instruction hidden in tooltip
